native_explainer.title: Як українська виражає мету, причину, адресата та інші зв’язки
native_explainer.body: В українській різні смислові зв’язки розподіляються між різними прийменниками, відмінками й конструкціями. «Для» + родовий часто позначає призначення, мету, одержувача або того, для чиєї користі щось робиться. Причину можна виразити «через» + знахідний. Тривалість часто передається «протягом» + родовий або часовою групою. Напрямок і кінцева межа залежать від дієслова та типу цілі: уживаються, зокрема, «до» + родовий і конструкції з «у/в» + знахідний. Обмін, ціну, заміну або підтримку часто передають конструкції з «за». Вибір форми залежить від конкретного смислового зв’язку в реченні.

rules.summary_en: Для + genitive commonly marks intended purpose, intended user, beneficiary, or intended recipient.
tips_en: Ask who benefits, who receives something, or what purpose is intended.
Treat для as one common construction among several semantic patterns.

rules.summary_en: Через + accusative can mark a cause or reason, especially an adverse or explanatory cause.
tips_en: Use a causal construction when the phrase explains why something happened.
The noun after через is accusative in this construction.

rules.summary_en: Протягом + genitive explicitly marks the duration or span during which something continues.
tips_en: Use this when the relation is elapsed duration or a time span.
Do not confuse elapsed duration with a deadline or target time.

rules.summary_en: До + genitive marks reaching a spatial endpoint or a temporal limit; destination wording may also use у/в + accusative depending on the motion construction.
tips_en: For a destination, learn the motion verb together with the required destination construction.
When до marks time, think endpoint or deadline rather than duration.

rules.summary_en: За + accusative occurs in common price, exchange, substitution, payment, and support/favor constructions.
tips_en: Check за when the relation is exchange, price, substitution, payment, or support.
Learn the whole construction because за has many unrelated meanings.

languages.notes: Lesson-focused candidate synthesis. Ukrainian motion/destination and temporal constructions are construction-sensitive; native review is required before stronger trust promotion.

native_explainer.title: Как русский выражает цель, причину, адресата и другие отношения
native_explainer.body: В русском разные смысловые отношения распределяются между предлогами, падежами и конструкциями. «Для» + родительный часто выражает назначение, цель, предполагаемого получателя или того, в чьих интересах что-то делается. Причину можно явно обозначить «из-за» + родительный или другими причинными конструкциями. Длительность передаётся, например, «в течение» + родительный или временной группой. Направление зависит от типа цели движения: используются «в/на» + винительный, «к» + дательный, «до» + родительный и другие модели. «До» также обозначает временную границу, а «за» + винительный часто встречается при цене, обмене, замене, оплате и поддержке. Форму выбирают по смысловой связи и управлению конкретной конструкции.

rules.summary_en: Для + genitive commonly marks intended recipient, intended use, purpose, or beneficiary.
tips_en: Ask whether the relation is intended use, purpose, recipient, or beneficiary.
Use the construction selected by the semantic role rather than extending для to unrelated roles.

rules.summary_en: Из-за + genitive marks cause or reason, commonly with an unwanted, problematic, or explanatory result.
tips_en: Choose a causal construction when the phrase explains what caused the result.
The governed noun is genitive.

rules.summary_en: В течение + genitive explicitly marks a span of time during which something happens or remains true.
tips_en: Use this family for elapsed duration or a bounded time span.
A duration is different from a deadline such as до пятницы.

forms.display: в/на + винительный; к + дательный; до + родительный

rules.summary_en: Russian destination and endpoint meanings are distributed across motion constructions such as в/на + accusative, к + dative, and до + genitive; до also marks a temporal endpoint/deadline.
tips_en: Learn destination marking with the motion verb and type of destination.
When до is temporal, read it as an endpoint, not as elapsed duration.

rules.summary_en: За + accusative is central in many price, exchange, payment, substitution, voting, and support/favor expressions.
tips_en: Check за when the relation is price, exchange, payment, substitution, voting, or support.
Because за has many other meanings, learn the complete phrase rather than the preposition in isolation.

native_explainer.title: Jak polski wyraża cel, przyczynę, odbiorcę i inne relacje
native_explainer.body: W polskim różne relacje znaczeniowe są rozdzielone między przyimki, przypadki i całe konstrukcje. «Dla» + dopełniacz często wskazuje beneficjenta, odbiorcę albo przeznaczenie. Cel może też wymagać «na» + biernik albo zdania z «żeby/aby». Przy cenie, wymianie, zastępstwie i poparciu często pojawia się «za» + biernik. Przyczynę wyraża m.in. «z powodu» + dopełniacz, a w części konstrukcji także «przez» + biernik. Czas trwania może być oznaczony przez «przez» + biernik, natomiast termin końcowy przez «do» + dopełniacz. Kierunek zależy od rodzaju miejsca i konstrukcji ruchu, np. «do Warszawy». Najpierw ustalamy relację znaczeniową, a potem wybieramy właściwą formę.

rules.summary_en: Dla + genitive commonly marks a beneficiary, intended audience/recipient, or intended purpose/use.
tips_en: Ask whether the phrase identifies a beneficiary, recipient, intended audience, or use.
Polish purpose is broader than dla; verbal goals often use other constructions.

rules.summary_en: Purpose can be expressed by na + accusative in many noun-goal constructions or by żeby/aby clauses for an explicit intended result.
tips_en: Choose the construction according to whether the goal is a noun phrase or a clause.
Do not assume one purpose marker covers every grammatical shape.

rules.summary_en: Z powodu + genitive is an explicit cause/reason construction; przez + accusative can also mark cause in many contexts.
tips_en: Use a cause construction when the phrase explains why something happened.
Przez can also be causal, so use the full phrase and context rather than a one-form rule.

rules.summary_en: Przez + accusative commonly marks the duration of an event or state.
tips_en: Use this construction when the relation is elapsed duration.
Keep duration separate from the deadline/endpoint meaning expressed with do.

rules.summary_en: Do + genitive commonly marks destination toward many places and a temporal endpoint/deadline.
tips_en: Destination marking depends on the kind of place, so learn the noun with its construction.
Temporal do means an endpoint, not a span of time.

rules.summary_en: Za + accusative occurs in common price, payment, exchange, substitution, voting, and support/favor constructions.
tips_en: Check za for price, exchange, payment, substitution, voting, or support relations.
Learn the entire phrase because za also has unrelated spatial and temporal uses.

languages.notes: WSJP PAN is used as the primary lexical authority; construction-level synthesis remains candidate pending Polish-native review.

native_explainer.title: Како македонскиот изразува цел, причина, примател и други односи
native_explainer.body: Во македонскиот различните смисловни односи се распределуваат меѓу различни предлози и конструкции. «За» често означува намена, нешто наменето за некого, крајна цел или противвредност. «За да» јасно воведува целна реченица. «Поради» најчесто означува причина, додека «заради» може да означува и цел и причина, зависно од контекстот. «До» означува просторна или временска граница, а «во текот на» временско траење. Изборот на формата зависи од смисловниот однос што го изразува конкретната реченица.

rules.summary_en: За commonly covers intended purpose/use, intended recipient/beneficiary, and destination/goal relationships in Macedonian.
tips_en: За is broad, but different semantic roles still depend on the surrounding construction.
Ask whether the phrase points toward an intended person, use, or endpoint.

rules.summary_en: За also occurs in common price, exchange, substitution, and countervalue constructions.
tips_en: Use a за construction when the relation is price, exchange, substitution, or countervalue.
Use the whole construction because за also marks several other relations.

rules.summary_en: За да introduces an explicit purpose clause, linking an action to the intended result.
tips_en: Use this when the purpose itself is expressed as a clause.
The official Macedonian dictionary explicitly describes за да as signaling the goal of the action.

rules.summary_en: Поради and заради mark cause; the official dictionary also records purpose/intention uses, especially for заради and in some поради contexts.
tips_en: Do not force a rigid one-form-per-meaning split here: the official dictionary records overlap.
Use context to distinguish an actual cause from an intended aim.

rules.summary_en: До marks a spatial limit/endpoint and a temporal limit, covering destination-endpoint and deadline relationships.
tips_en: Think of до as reaching a boundary.
A temporal boundary is a deadline/endpoint, not elapsed duration.

rules.summary_en: Во текот на marks the span during which something happens or continues.
tips_en: Use this construction for a duration or time span.
Keep duration separate from the temporal endpoint expressed with до.
